title: Footwork, frame by frame.
subtitle: Watch the sequence. Hold the detail. Choose your next rep.
review_status: Authored demo moments · automatic ball tracking

phases.label: Pause
phases.detail: The sequence ends; player bends down

moments.title: Around the ball
moments.body: A foot moves around the ball while the other stays beside it. Hold this frame, then watch the pass at half speed.

moments.title: Watch the next pass
moments.body: The next foot comes around from the opposite side. Compare the two passes in slow replay; this clip does not show an exit touch.

moments.title: Where is the exit?
moments.body: The player pauses and bends down. Add the first exit touch and two steps after the move in your next recording.

notes.title: Both sides are visible
notes.body: The feet alternate around the ball, so each side can be compared in replay.

notes.title: A clear reset position
notes.body: The ball sits between the feet between passes. Use that reset as your replay checkpoint.

notes.title: Show the full move
notes.body: Record head to foot and finish with an exit touch plus two steps. This angle cannot show an upper-body feint or its outcome.

next_rep: Record one full-body feint, the cut, and the first two exit steps.

measurement.label: Normalized image motion
measurement.definition: Adjacent accepted ball-center displacement in normalized image coordinates, divided by the maximum observed in this clip. Missing frames or new track IDs create gaps. No physical units, no speed claim; camera movement is included.
measurement.confidence_note: Detector scores are not correctness probabilities. Coverage is not accuracy.

limits: Phase names, moment timing and review notes were marked by AI-assisted visual review; they are not an automatic skill classifier.
The ball ring and motion graph use actual detector output. Coordinates are never filled across a tracking loss.
The source shows footwork followed by a pause, not a complete body feint and cut. No skill rating or speed is inferred.
